meta.name: agent-role-orchestrator
meta.description: Route CEO-first multi-window work into owner-led role loops. Use for 总控/CEO、架构/CTO、内容主编、角色派发与复用、模型路由、来源窗口回调、role-windows 台账、skill 命中统计或 multi-window loop engineering。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将多窗口工作路由到角色驱动的循环中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个窗口间协调不同角色的工作流
copy.tagline_en: Route multi-window work into role-driven loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate role-based workflows across multiple windows

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“总控→负责人→执行角色”的层级来拆解任务，自动选择最浅的协作回路，并生成任务分发决策。它还会维护角色窗口台账，确保每个任务都有明确的负责人和闭环回调。
howto.when: 当你提出一个需要多人协作或跨角色分工的任务时触发，例如软件开发、内容发布或架构设计。

say.text: 帮我规划一个Web应用开发，从架构到测试。
say.note: Claude会按总控→CTO→开发等角色层级分配任务。

say.text: 写一篇小红书笔记，并发布。
say.note: Claude会调用内容主编角色，并触发内容路由和发布流程。

say.text: 检查当前项目的角色窗口状态。
say.note: Claude会读取项目台账并更新状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will decompose tasks using a 'CEO → owner → executor' hierarchy, automatically select the shallowest collaboration loop, and output a task dispatch decision. It also maintains a role-windows ledger and ensures each task has a clear owner and closed-loop callback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a task requiring multi-role collaboration or role-based delegation, such as software development, content publishing, or architecture design.

say_en.text: Plan a web app development from architecture to testing.
say_en.note: Claude will assign roles from CEO to CTO to developers.

say_en.text: Write a Xiaohongshu post and publish it.
Check the current project's role window status.
say_en.note: Claude will read the project ledger and update status.
